overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate the certification topic 48 hours before the meeting, and the Board had no duty to meet in executive session, though the Board should have postponed the vote.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly revised its posted notice less than 48 hours before its February 22, 2011 meeting to add a discussion and vote on a building inspector's certification status and dismissal.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Chair did not reasonably anticipate this as a topic for discussion 48 hours before the Board's February 22, 2011 meeting, it was not unlawful to add the topic to the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant contended the Board should have discussed his termination in executive session rather than in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Public bodies are under no obligation to meet in closed session for any reason.
